interface.signature: def print_next_greater_freq(arr: list[int], n: int) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: The length of the input array must exactly match the given integer n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**4 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Every element in the array must be an integer between 1 and 10^4 (inclusive).
The size of the array must be between 1 and 10^4 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output list must have exactly n elements, one for each element in the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(answer[i] == -1 or (answer[i] in arr[i+1:] and arr.count(answer[i]) > arr.count(arr[i])) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each element at index i, if answer[i] is not -1, it must be the closest element to the right of arr[i] with a strictly greater frequency than arr[i].

postconditions.expression: all(answer[i] == -1 or arr.index(answer[i], i+1) < arr.index(x, i+1) for i in range(n) for x in arr[i+1:] if arr.count(x) > arr.count(arr[i]))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple elements to the right with greater frequency, the closest one (first occurrence) must be chosen.
